source.title: Google’s Project Suncatcher to put ML infrastructure in space
source.author: xnx

title.zh: Project Suncatcher：谷歌测试太空AI算力
title.en: Project Suncatcher: Google Tests AI in Space

excerpt.zh: Project Suncatcher将把谷歌TPU送入低地球轨道，验证辐射、振动与真空散热问题，但距离可扩展的太空AI基础设施仍很遥远。
excerpt.en: Project Suncatcher will test Google TPUs in orbit against radiation, vibration, and vacuum cooling limits, but scalable space AI remains distant.

text.zh: Project Suncatcher先验证硬件能否入轨
text.en: Project Suncatcher First Tests Whether AI Hardware Can Survive Orbit

text.zh: Project Suncatcher是谷歌探索太空机器学习基础设施的长期研究项目。首个原型卫星计划搭载SpaceX的Transporter-18共享发射任务升空，并与Planet合作，重点收集谷歌Tensor Processing Unit（TPU）在发射和轨道环境中的实际数据。
text.en: Project Suncatcher is Google's long-term research effort to explore machine learning infrastructure in space. Its first prototype satellite is planned for SpaceX's Transporter-18 rideshare mission, developed with Planet, and will collect real-world data on Google Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) during launch and in orbit.

text.zh: 发射阶段的振动和加速度会给芯片带来显著机械压力；进入轨道后，太阳活动和宇宙射线可能引发电子错误。谷歌称，地面质子束测试显示其Trillium TPU能够承受高于五年空间任务预期的总电离剂量，但只有在轨运行才能检验这些结果是否适用于真实环境。
text.en: Launch vibration and acceleration create substantial mechanical stress for the chips, while solar events and cosmic rays can cause electronic errors in orbit. Google says ground-based proton-beam tests indicate its Trillium TPUs can withstand a total ionizing dose greater than the expected exposure of a five-year space mission, but only an orbital test can show how that result holds in practice.

text.zh: 太空AI的关键瓶颈是散热与连接
text.en: Cooling and Connectivity Are the Hard Parts of Space AI

text.zh: 太空中的太阳能条件可能有利于供电，但真空没有空气对流，TPU集中产生的热量只能通过热管、散热器等路径排出。谷歌已在热真空舱中测试冷却方案，计划利用首次任务继续调整设计。未来设想还包括让搭载多块TPU的卫星组成集群，并用激光建立高带宽的短距离链路。
text.en: Sunlight in orbit could offer an attractive power source, but vacuum eliminates air convection, so heat from densely packed TPUs must be removed through systems such as heat pipes and radiators. Google has tested cooling approaches in a thermal-vacuum chamber and plans to refine them with the first mission. A longer-term concept would place dozens of TPUs on satellite clusters linked by high-bandwidth laser connections.

text.zh: Project Suncatcher仍处于早期验证阶段
text.en: Project Suncatcher Is Still an Early Feasibility Test

text.zh: 这次任务不能证明太空数据中心已经具备商业可行性，也不能说明大规模AI工作负载能够稳定运行。卫星间精确对准、持续散热、辐射容错和维护成本都仍待验证。谷歌计划在2027年测试两颗卫星之间的激光通信；在获得这些在轨数据前，太空算力更应被看作工程研究方向，而不是现成的基础设施替代方案。
text.en: This mission will not prove that space-based data centers are commercially viable, nor that large AI workloads can run reliably there. Precise satellite pointing, sustained thermal management, radiation tolerance, and maintenance costs remain unresolved. Google plans to test laser communication between two satellites in 2027; until those orbital results arrive, space compute is best understood as an engineering research direction rather than a ready replacement for terrestrial infrastructure.
